subject: DT table row selection not working after first selection

messages.author: 6794969ce0cf57b0
messages.subject: DT table row selection not working after first selection
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if anyone has come across this issue.

When I select a row in one table, to generate a new data frame that is displayed in a second table it work for the first selection. However, for any subsequent selections the second table is refreshed but it is as if the original row was selected.

This behavior has only happens when I publish the app to our internal server and has only started happening recently; it performs as expected on my personal machine and has worked on the server in the recent past (I have actually tried it on two different servers and had the same issue)

I guess it is probably a package version issue but any thoughts would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks

Iain

messages.subject: Re: DT table row selection not working after first selection

I think you can first compare the output of library(DT);sessionInfo()
between your personal machine and the server.
